text: いっしょに　いた　ラプラスは　こどもの　ときに　いてだきのどうくつで　であった　ラプラス　じゃろう　ずっと　いっしょ　だったのかのう

structure.jp: いっしょに　いた　ラプラスは
structure.en: the Lapras that was with her

structure.jp: こどもの　ときに　いてだきのどうくつで　であった　ラプラス　じゃろう
structure.en: is probably the Lapras she met in Icefall Cave as a child

structure.jp: ずっと　いっしょ　だったのかのう
structure.en: I wonder if they were together all along

patterns.name: verb + noun
patterns.span: いっしょに　いた　ラプラス
patterns.explanation: A short sentence placed right before a noun describes that noun. いっしょに　いた　ラプラス = 'the Lapras that was with her'.

patterns.name: 〜だろう
patterns.span: ラプラス　じゃろう
patterns.explanation: だろう at the end means 'probably'. じゃろう is the old-man way of saying it. ラプラス　じゃろう = 'it's probably the Lapras'.

patterns.name: 〜かな
patterns.explanation: かな at the end means 'I wonder'. のう is the old-man version of な. だったのかのう = 'I wonder if they were'.
